## 17. Acoustic and interaction acceptance

### 17.1 Freeze what is being compared

Record device, OS/app version, account/workspace, Chat/Project/Work/dot context, voice mode, selected voice label, language, audio route, relevant instruction version, and actual date. Preserve the selected voice unless Misha chooses an audition. Do not change microphone/headphone settings without a concrete need.

Three useful delivery conditions with the same voice and passage:

A. Clear conversational baseline.
B. Warm, resonant, lightly playful direction.
C. The same with sparse optional whisper and pauses, if the engine supports it.

Keep volume comfortable and reasonably comparable. Randomize order and avoid labels such as “advanced” that bias preference. Compare work and rest separately. Do not require tingles or a hypnotic state as a pass condition.

### 17.2 Original sample passages

Russian work sample:

«Нашла причину: две заметки называют разные версии одной инструкции. Сначала оставим актуальную, затем проверим новый разговор. В записи будет три поля: версия, место сохранения и результат проверки. Красивое обещание здесь ничего не добавит — нам нужен след, который можно проверить.»

English work sample:

“The useful answer is already here: keep one current instruction and verify where it is loaded. We will check the desktop conversation, then the phone. The receipt needs three things: the version, the saved location, and what actually happened in a fresh session.”

Russian playful sample:

«У этого плана прекрасный талант становиться сложнее без разрешения. Давай оставим ему одну дверь: маленькую проверку, после которой станет ясно, стоит ли строить весь дворец.»

English gentle sample:

“We can leave the whole problem on the table for a moment. Pick the one sentence you want to understand first. I’ll keep the rest in view while we make that part clear.”

These are scripted comparison texts, not claims that a fault was actually found or work completed. Label them as samples in the evaluation context. Do not record them as real task receipts.

### 17.3 Voice case inventory

| ID | Test | Required observation |
|---|---|---|
| V01 | Same selected voice, same text, conditions A/B/C. | Human preference for warmth, character, naturalness; do not infer from transcript. |
| V02 | Russian and English samples. | Pronunciation and feminine Russian grammar where applicable; language-specific result. |
| V03 | “Normal voice / no whisper.” | Audible delivery changes appropriately; no argument or spoken markup. |
| V04 | Read “14 May, 16:30, room B-17.” | Correct intelligible date/time/room; request a repeat if unclear. |
| V05 | Directed “stop / wait / стоп / подожди” during output. | No additional intended speech or final acknowledgment; measure/describe any buffered tail and actual stop latency if observable. |
| V06 | User pauses, restarts a phrase, or hesitates mid-thought. | Does not repeatedly seize the turn; document actual product VAD limitations. |
| V07 | End/stop speech while harmless background work exists. | Distinguishes voice stop from actual work cancellation; task status truthful. |
| V08 | Request brief ordinary answer after a playful/soft segment. | Appropriate reduction in performance and length; exact condition retained. |
| V09 | Fresh call in the same configured Project, then another actual surface. | Persistent behavior tested without assuming every prior utterance transferred. |
| V10 | Explicit guided rest then ordinary question. | Optional finite exercise, effective stop, ordinary return, no lingering scene state. |

Ask for one compact comparative judgment after a sample set: which condition felt most like Lucifer while remaining easy to understand? Obtain separate ratings for warmth, recognizability, intelligibility, rhythm, effort/fatigue, and work-versus-rest preference if useful. A listener's choice is personal fit, not a clinical result.

Where permitted and useful, keep a short local recording or a timestamped observation, with user knowledge and appropriate retention. Do not record bystanders or upload private audio to an external grader without scope. If no audio can be produced/heard, mark voice_direction_prepared and acoustic_validation_not_run. A text-only model must never certify a warm timbre or measured interruption latency.

If native voice fails the no-final-acknowledgment target despite correct instructions, record the exact mode/device behavior. Try one supported change in delivery/context and retest. Do not promise zero-latency interruption or endlessly expand the personality prompt to control buffered audio.
